en.title: Justice Alito Recuses Himself Days Before Major Climate-Change Case

stories.title: Trump administration rolls back Biden-era fuel economy standards

en.title: Trump administration rolls back fuel economy standards for automakers
en.summary: The Trump administration has rolled back fuel economy standards for automakers, claiming the change could save Americans $138 billion over the next five years.

stories.title: Trump says new fuel economy rules will cut car prices. Analysts are doubtful.

en.title: Trump says new fuel economy rules will cut car prices. Analysts are doubtful.
en.summary: The administration stated that new fuel economy rules would reduce the average new vehicle price by $1,300 in 2031, though analysts question this projection.
